title: "People"
page-layout: full

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Reads the YAML files in people/ (generated from people.csv by scripts/generate_people.R)
source("r/utils.R")   # md_escape()
esc <- htmltools::htmlEscape

initials <- function(x) {
  w <- strsplit(trimws(x), "\\s+")[[1]]
  toupper(paste0(substr(w[unique(c(1, length(w)))], 1, 1), collapse = ""))
}

card <- function(p) {
  name <- as.character(p$name)
  inst <- if (is.null(p$institution)) "" else as.character(p$institution)
  pic  <- if (!is.null(p$image)) {
    paste0('<img src="', esc(p$image), '" alt="', esc(name), '" loading="lazy">')
  } else {
    paste0('<div class="avatar" aria-hidden="true">', esc(initials(name)), '</div>')
  }
  paste0('<div class="person">', pic,
         '<div class="person-name">', esc(name), '</div>',
         if (nzchar(inst)) paste0('<div class="person-inst">', esc(inst), '</div>') else "",
         '</div>')
}

files <- sort(list.files("people", pattern = "\\.ya?ml$", full.names = TRUE))
if (!length(files)) cat("*No people found - check people.csv.*\n")

for (f in files) {
  d <- yaml::read_yaml(f, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  cards <- vapply(d$people, card, character(1))
  cat("\n\n## ", md_escape(as.character(d$role)), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("```{=html}\n<div class=\"people-grid\">\n", paste(cards, collapse = "\n"), "\n</div>\n```\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{=html}
<style>
  .people-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 1.8rem 1.5rem; margin: 1rem 0 2.5rem; }
  .person { text-align: center; }
  .person img, .person .avatar { width: 130px; height: 130px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; margin: 0 auto .7rem; display: block; }
  .person .avatar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #e5e7eb; color: #4b5563; font-size: 2.1rem; font-weight: 600; }
  .person-name { font-weight: 600; }
  .person-inst { font-size: .9rem; opacity: .7; }
</style>
```
